info.title: Blast Radius public evidence snapshot
info.description: Read-only static JSON for six deliberately selected companies. Not live monitoring, enrichment, a complete outage history, or qualified pipeline. No API key required. Local CLI/MCP return structured not_covered for unknown domains; a static URL outside the published index returns the host's ordinary HTTP404, not a health verdict.
